info.name: Check the status of a cross chain transfer

params.name: txHash
params.description: The transaction hash on the sending chain, destination chain or lifi step id

params.name: bridge
params.description: The bridging tool used for the transfer

params.name: fromChain
params.description: The sending chain. Can be the chain id or chain key

params.name: toChain
params.description: The receiving chain. Can be the chain id or chain key

items.docs:
Cross chain transfers might take a while to complete. Waiting on the transaction on the sending chain doesn't help here. For this reason we build a simple endpoint that let's you check the status of your transfer.
Important: The endpoint returns a `200` successful response even if the transaction can not be found. This behavior accounts for the case that the transaction hash is valid but the transaction has not been mined yet.
